unavailable.title: AI is not set up yet
unavailable.body: These AI tools need a connection to the AI service, and your institution doesn’t have one yet. Everything else in SchoolGiant works as usual.
unavailable.how: Ask SchoolGiant support to turn on AI for your institution. Once it is connected, this page comes alive on its own — nothing to install.
unavailable.privacy: Only what a task needs is sent — first names, classes and marks. Never phone numbers, addresses or ID numbers. Every request is logged in your usage.

assistant.p1: Ask about attendance, fee dues, exam results, staff leave, the calendar and timetables in plain words.
assistant.p2: Answers come from your own data, through your role’s permissions — it can’t see what you can’t.
assistant.p3: Each answer shows what it looked up, so you can check the figures.

questionPapers.p1: Pick an exam paper, the chapters and how many questions of each type.
questionPapers.p2: Get draft questions with answers and marking schemes in seconds.
questionPapers.p3: Keep the good ones: they go to the question bank and straight into your draft paper.

remarks.p1: Pick an exam and a section; each student’s marks, attendance and progress are gathered for you.
remarks.p2: Get a one- or two-sentence remark per student in your school’s tone.
remarks.p3: Edit, redo any row, and save them all onto the report cards at once.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about your school’s attendance, fees, results, leave, calendar and timetable — answered from your own data.
assistant.intro: Ask a question about your institution. Here are a few to start with:
assistant.placeholder: Ask about attendance, fees, results, leave…
assistant.cannotAsk: Your role can see this page but not ask questions.
assistant.noAnswer: No answer came back. Try asking again.
assistant.failed: The assistant couldn’t answer. Try again.
assistant.refused: The assistant declined this one. Try putting it another way.
assistant.truncated: The answer was cut short. Ask a narrower question for the rest.
assistant.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Check important figures on the screen they come from.
assistant.privacy: It sees only what your role can see, and never phone numbers, addresses or ID numbers.
